newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: S.LANKA TEA PRICES BUOYANT ON GOOD GENERAL DEMAND.
newsitem.headline: S.LANKA TEA PRICES BUOYANT ON GOOD GENERAL DEMAND.

text.p: Prices at the Colombo tea auctions were up on Tuesday, due strong demand from the CIS which was supported by other traditional buyers, brokers said.
"Demand from the CIS was supported by traditional buyers from Japan, North America, Germany and the Netherlands," said Lal Alawattegama of produce brokers Forbes & Walker.
"There was some interest also from Pakistan, United Kingdom, and South Africa," he added.
The anticipated gross sales average was 122 rupees as aginast 120.54 last week, said Forbes & Walker.
The next auction is on August 19-20, when 5.7 million kg will be on offer. ($=58.89 rupees) -- Colombo newsroom (941) 434319
